description: Complex survey analysis: strata/PSU/weights, variance estimation (Taylor, BRR, jackknife, bootstrap), survey GLM, domain analysis, calibration, survey data I/O (SAS, SPSS, Stata formats). Polars-native. Use for any complex-sample survey: NHANES, CPS, ACS PUMS, BRFSS, DHS, ECLS-K, MEPS-HC. CRITICAL: statsmodels WLS and pyfixest clustered SEs are NOT substitutes for proper survey-weighted analysis — they ignore stratification and unequal probability sampling. Non-survey regression: statsmodels/pyfixest. R equivalent: survey-r (use when execution language is R).
